knowledge:
- key_parameters: benhur(data, fraction, max_clusters, seednum) = data is an ExpressionSet or matrix, fraction (e.g., 0.7) is the proportion of samples to subset, max_clusters (e.g., 6) is the maximum number of clusters to test, and seednum ensures reproducibility ;; clusterComp(data, k) = data is an ExpressionSet or matrix, and k is the chosen number of clusters to test for stability.
- alternatives: hclust() is the default underlying hierarchical clustering method, but the package notes the approach can be generalized to other clustering algorithms. The genefilter package (specifically the cv() function) is recommended for non-specific gene filtering prior to clustering.
- when_to_use: Use this package when performing unsupervised hierarchical clustering on transcriptomics/microarray data and you need to rigorously determine the optimal number of clusters and validate whether the resulting clusters are stable and not due to random chance.
- pitfalls: Avoid filtering genes based on expected differences between known sample groups before clustering, as this creates a self-fulfilling prophecy where clusters appear artificially distinct. Use non-specific filtering (like coefficient of variation) instead. Clustering is highly sensitive to small changes in input data (adding/removing samples or genes), making stability validation essential.

workflows.name: cluster_number_and_stability_analysis
workflows.intent: Estimate the optimal number of clusters in microarray data and test the stability of the chosen clusters.
input: fibroEset (ExpressionSet containing microarray gene expression data)
workflows.stages: 1. Filter genes using coefficient of variation (CV) to avoid bias ;; 2. Estimate the number of clusters using the benhur function ;; 3. Visualize the cluster number distribution using hist and ecdf ;; 4. Perform hierarchical clustering and plot the dendrogram ;; 5. Test the stability of the selected number of clusters using clusterComp
workflows.code:
library(clusterStab)
library(genefilter)
library(fibroEset)
data(fibroEset)
exprs(fibroEset) <- log2(exprs(fibroEset))
filt <- cv(0.1, Inf)
index <- genefilter(fibroEset, filt)
fb <- fibroEset[index,]
bh <- benhur(fb, 0.7, 6, seednum = 12345) #seednum only used to ensure reproducibility
hist(bh)
plot(hclust(dist(t(exprs(fibroEset[index,])))), labels = pData(fibroEset)[,2], sub="", xlab="")
ecdf(bh)
cmp <- clusterComp(fb, 2)
cmp
